mentions.name: Bitcoin secp/secr curve backdoor search
mentions.description: This research effort searches for a mathematical backdoor in Bitcoin's secp and secr elliptic curves, examining the generator order primes and attempting to define a multiplication operation using primitive roots, with findings documented in Substack articles.
mentions.problem: Both curves use unsafe primes (p-1 factors well) for the generator order, raising the concern of a possible backdoor like the earlier Dual EC backdoor in an elliptic curve.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Super silly but I'm searching for a mathematical backdoor in Bitcoin's secp and the secr curve. I saw that both curves use unsafe primes (p-1 factors pretty well) for the generator order.

So I'm trying to define a multiplication operation using primitive roots.

[0] https://leetarxiv.substack.com/p/if-youre-smart-why-are-you-poor-elliptic

[1] (The other time the US gov put a backdoor in an elliptic curve) https://leetarxiv.substack.com/p/dual-ec-backdoor-coding-guide
